scope: Register each nonzero source DIMASSOC handle to its emitted DXF OBJECTS record transactionally, and verify failure rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback.

change.implementation: writeDimensionAssociation now opens RecordStateScope before writer-side allocations, binds the nonzero source handle to the emitted handle before committing the record, and commits the state scope only after record commit.
regressionCoverage: The exact ASCII/Binary round-trip helper checks the sourceHandleToWrittenObjectMap binding after direct record output.
Every injected allocation failure verifies destination sentinel preservation and absence of a partial DIMASSOC source identity.
Same-codec retry verifies one exact source-to-emitted identity binding and fresh typed readback.

limitations: This proves output identity bookkeeping and transaction behavior for the tested DIMASSOC writer profiles; it does not prove producer-wide source spans, all owner/reactor role variants, or native associative updates.
Physical whole-drawing output remains subject to the separate frame, graph-closure, and strict-output gates.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 source/object identity and transaction audit only where a concrete writer path lacks its required source binding or rollback proof; retain unresolved producer and semantic gates.
